q1_issues.issue: (Possession sk_witness_1 reuters) is applied without its licence: the possessive/genitive rule is triggered by 's, a possessive pronoun, or a possessive of-phrase, and "Reuters witnesses" is a bare proper-noun attributive with none of those.

"crying children" is a pre-nominal participle, which the lemmatization rule makes an adjectival modifier of the noun, not the reified (Member sk_cry_1 cry) (Agent ...) (Ongoing ...) event the parse emits (the reduced-relative event form is specified for POST-modifiers).

(Member sk_square_1 packed) and (Member sk_person_1 homeless) predicate properties of the group symbols — the group-as-object reading the plural rules explicitly warn against — rather than distributing to the members.
The flat copular atom for "were packed" is left untensed: a past copular wraps every categorical atom the clause yields, so it should be a Past-wrapped atom beside the reified state.

(Source sk_protect_1 cold) mis-slots "protect them from the cold": the PP does not answer whence but names what is protected against, so by the decide-by-the-question rule it takes the preposition-named oblique.

q2_gaps: a proper-noun attributive modifier on a common noun ("Reuters witnesses") — the multi-word-name rule only covers a kind word naming the named entity itself, compound fusion explicitly excludes proper nouns, and the genitive rule needs a possessive marker

an episodic bare plural ("public squares were packed", "people left homeless", "Reuters witnesses said") — the determiner rule sends a bare plural to the generic kind, so there is no licensed way to predicate a one-off episodic property of specific but unindividuated plurals
distribution inside a seal — a plural inside a sealed complement cannot take the per-member Implication rule the distributive treatment calls for
notes: The non-factive `say` seal, the adjective-PP-complement state reification carrying With, the "left homeless" resultative shape, and the purpose infinitive (To sk_huddle_1 sk_protect_1) are all per spec, as is the coreference of "them" back to the people. Experiencer on the postural "huddled" is defensible and its reification is licensed by the purpose-clause endpoint.
